name: Never Gonna Give You Up — Rick Astley — Jam with everything
description: Press Play: a MIDI file plays the melody and bass on a WebCLAP piano. Play along on your computer keyboard, the onscreen piano, any MIDI controller, a gamepad or the mouse; a Harmoniser keeps every note in A♭ major on a WebCLAP organ. Another application can control everything through the audioBus Protocol input: notes, aftertouch, pitch bend and controllers as MIDI commands, the transport, and every control in the command palette. Pair it from the input panel, or tick Accept control from any window to allow trusted pages without pairing. Source: https://bitmidi.com/never-gonna-give-you-up-1-mid
